title: Law 4 Fruits Tier 1: Love→Peace→Joy Forced Ordering
claim: From the Cornell/Yukawa potential V(r) = −α_s/r + k·r, one stationary calculation produces: Love (agapē) = V'_eff(d*)=0 (the equilibrium itself). Peace (eirēnē) = V''_eff(d*)>0 (stability — positive curvature). Joy (chara) = ω₀=√(V''(d*)/μ) (oscillation, real only when V''>0). The ordering is a theorem: Joy requires Peace (V''>0 for ω₀ real), Peace exists within Love (the equilibrium). Two-tier ruling (July 29, 2026): Tier 1 is DERIVED from the stationary calculation. Tier 2 (remaining six fruits) are STRUCTURAL CORRESPONDENCES.
assumptions: Cornell/Yukawa potential as parent equation for Law 4 (Strong Force)
definitions: Love: V'_eff(d*)=0, the potential well minimum
Peace: V''_eff(d*)>0, positive curvature at minimum
Joy: ω₀=√(V''(d*)/μ), oscillation frequency real only when V''>0
bridges: Strong nuclear force (Yukawa/Cornell) → Fruits of the Spirit (Galatians 5:22-23)
negative_guards: Tier 2 fruits (Patience, Kindness, Goodness, Faithfulness, Gentleness, Self-Control) are correspondences, not derivations.
The ordering is forced by the mathematics. The NAMING is a bridge claim.
Anti-fruits (Hatred, Despair, Anxiety, etc.) are the entropic direction of the same equations.
kill_conditions: Show that V'_eff(d*)=0 does NOT require V''_eff(d*)>0 for stability.
Show that ω₀ can be real without V''>0.
Show that the ordering Love→Peace→Joy can be permuted under the same potential.
